apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 188 merges the latest upstream iOS Home/Store, queue, library, Settings and older-iOS H.265 updates while preserving the newer Metal 4 presentation/stutter patches and 2560×1080 near-native MetalFX support. Adds independent displayed FPS/renderer/GPU HUD toggles, refined GeForce NOW joystick rings/grip dots/center hub/Back-Start proportions, and cleaner Controller settings with a dedicated shortcuts page. Retains vibration, Mobile Game controls, immersive mode and Sessions history. Device Release archive passed; merged code: 223 parity tests passed, one hardware-only skip, three iPad checks passed; four Mac GPU validators passed. Unsigned KravaSigner build for a same-settings gameplay retest.
